defs.def: to stop doing your job, especially because you have reached a particular age or because you are ill/sick; to tell sb they must stop doing their job （令）退职；（使）退休

ex.s: Current students, teachers (including retired) and staff can request items through ILL.
ex.t: 在校学生、教师（含退休）和员工可通过ILL申请物品。

ex.s: One doubter about the safety of cloud seeding is Chuck Doswell, a research scientist who just retired from the University of Oklahoma.
ex.t: 对人工降雨安全性持怀疑态度的人之一是查克·多斯韦尔，他是一名刚从俄克拉荷马大学退休的研究科学家。

ex.s: When she retired from dancing and her sons eventually flew the nest, she decided it was time to take the plunge.
ex.t: 当她从舞蹈事业退休，儿子们最终离巢后，她决定是时候迈出这一步了。

ex.s: Mike Sullivan, a former construction worker, took up woodworking after he and his wife, Judy, retired.
ex.t: 迈克·沙利文是一名前建筑工人，他和妻子朱迪退休后开始从事木工。

ex.s: He never stopped working, never retired.
ex.t: 他从不停下工作，从不退休。

ex.s: Researchers from the University of Leipzig in Germany gathered more than 1, 000 retired workers who were over age 75 and assessed the volunteers’ memory and thinking skills through a battery of tests.
ex.t: 德国莱比锡大学的研究人员召集了1000多名75岁以上的退休工人，通过一系列测试评估志愿者的记忆力和思维能力。

ex.s: Retired Workers Can Pick Up New Skills
ex.t: 退休工人可以掌握新技能

ex.s: He's not ready to retire, but he's found a new hobby to keep his hands skillful in the years to come.
ex.t: 他还没准备退休，但已找到一项新爱好，让他的双手在未来岁月里保持灵巧。

ex.s: Picking up her“Lifetime Achievement”award，proud Irene   64  （declare） she had no plans   65   （retire） from her 36-year-old business.
ex.t: 捧起她的"终身成就奖"，自豪的艾琳宣布她没有退休的计划，不想离开她经营了36年的企业。

ex.s: A retired engineer, 76-year-old Wilson has been   11   free rides to college students for the past eight years.
ex.t: 76岁的退休工程师威尔逊，过去八年一直在给大学生___11___免费搭载。

ex.s: Liu Yonghui, retired teacher 1 Eating out is a good choice and it has nothing to do with loss of traditions.
ex.t: 刘永辉，退休教师 1 外出就餐是一个不错的选择，这与传统的丧失无关。

ex.s: Lu retired from teaching only two years before passing away in 2016.
ex.t: 陆老师在2016年去世前仅仅退休了两年。

ex.s: You know we’ll have a good time then.” Verse 4 I’ve long since retired, my son’s moved away.
ex.t: 你知道我们会玩得很开心。" 第四节 我早已退休，儿子也已搬走。

ex.s: Dr Lin did not retire until the day she died, 22 April 1983.
ex.t: 林医生直到1983年4月22日去世那天才退休。

defs.def: to stop competing during a game, race, etc., usually because you are injured （因伤）退出（比赛等）

ex.t: 香克利于1974年从利物浦退役。

defs.def: to leave a place, especially to go somewhere quieter or more private 离开（尤指去僻静处）
to move back from a battle in order to organize your soldiers in a different way 撤离，撤退（以进行休整）
to go to bed 睡觉；就寝
to make a player or team have to stop their turn at batting 使（击球员、击球方）出局

chunks.en: retire workers / son / staff / teacher / engineer
chunks.cn: 退休雇员 / 退休儿子 / 退休大、中、小学的） / 退休老师 / 退休工程师
